subject: Film & Cinema
title: New German Cinema: Fassbinder and Herzog
description: A quick, practical guide to New German Cinema: Fassbinder and Herzog.

hook.text: In 1962, German filmmakers signed a manifesto: 'The old cinema is dead.'

buildup.text: Fassbinder, Herzog, and Wenders rebuilt German cinema from the ashes of Nazi shame.

discovery.text: Fassbinder made 44 films in 15 years — exploring power, desire, and German guilt.

twist.text: Herzog dragged a steamship over a mountain for one shot. His ambition was literal.

climax.text: New German Cinema proved a national cinema could rebuild itself through sheer artistic will.

punchline.text: They killed the old cinema and built a new one.

quiz.question: What did the Oberhausen Manifesto declare?
